rules: INCOMPLETE if any seed lacks an OK cell for any encoder
EVALUATOR_UNRESOLVED if informative < 0.90 in any seed or |memoryless - 0.5| > 0.10 in any seed
CURRENT_BENCHMARK_NONDISCRIMINATIVE if (informative - random) < 0.10 in every seed
HEADROOM_PRESENT if (informative - random) >= 0.10 in every seed
full-action success/return/timeout are reported, not used for the verdict

frozen_before_run: 2026-09-26; seeds, encoders, epoch candidates, selection rule, thresholds and caps fixed before any diagnostic metric was computed

head.selection_rule: lowest dev reward_mse among checkpoints of one 80-epoch run; ties -> fewer epochs; test never used

head_input: per-dimension z-score, statistics fitted on train-split history prefixes only
name: diag_eval_discriminability_v1

not_run.acp_msp_reference_eval: no ACP/MSP checkpoints exist (runner stored hashes only); retraining not in scope
not_run.asymmetric_variant: R1 is defined on the symmetric variant; CPU cap
not_run.raw_unstandardized_head_input: CPU cap; standardized input is applied identically to all encoders

question: Can the current environment plus the frozen-encoder reward head and planner discriminate added value of representation learning (headroom for pilot comparison R1)?
seed_note: Diagnostic-only seeds, disjoint from pilot seeds 0-9. After this run their splits are development material, not confirmatory data. Three seeds of one variant are not an independent-replication claim.
